integrity: The exact finite claim is established by exhaustive construction of every relevant endpoint-localized chain group and exact boundary-rank computation from a self-contained construction of the graph; the literature comparison is used only for context and coverage checks.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to bidegree \((3,5)\) over \(\mathbb F_2\) for the Tutte–Coxeter graph. It does not assert integral or odd-characteristic ranks, other bidegrees, or a general girth-eight cycle-count theorem.
title: Second off-diagonal magnitude homology of the Tutte–Coxeter graph
